info.title: Overdrive API
info.description: Gear prices, the daily toll, exact quotes, unsigned transaction intents, the Governor page and the exit reserve. Read only: it reads Postgres and the chain, holds no key and sends nothing.

output.description: Immediate: what the transaction pays now. Queued: the expected proceeds at the current price after the spread (an estimate, paid at the next fresh price); null when no price is known to estimate from. Never 0 for a queued sell.

baseUnits.description: Integer in the token's base units.

minimumOutput.description: The minimum the transaction is built with. Queued: the ticket's minimum, the floor the queue honours.

outputIsEstimate.description: True for a queued sell: output is an estimate, the ticket is paid at the next fresh price.

settlement.description: Queued sells only: how the ticket is paid.

sellMode.description: Sells only (null for a buy). instant: the market is open. instant_min: the market is closed, a sell now pays the lower of the last value and the reference value. queued: no fresh price, the sell waits for the next fresh price.
